name: Phin & Night Catering
tagline: Coffee and bánh mì from 8am to midnight for hackathons of 100 to 300, and personalized coffee kits for your customers.
bio: I'm Linh. I feed hackathons: a phin coffee bar in the morning, bánh mì at lunch, noodles at midnight, and coffee again at 2am if you need it. I also make coffee gift kits with each person's name, delivered by hand in SF.
terms: Free to cancel up to 10 days before. Headcount can change until 72 hours before.
backupPlan: Two crews; if one van breaks down, the other comes.

experiences.name: Hackathon catering, 8am to midnight
experiences.desc: Phin coffee bar all day, bánh mì lunch, rice bowls for dinner, a noodle drop at midnight, snacks in between.
includes: Lunch, dinner and a midnight noodle drop
Snacks and drinks restocked all day
experiences.allIn: Food, coffee, staff, compostables, delivery in the Bay Area and tax.
experiences.dietary: Every meal has vegan and gluten-free options, labelled.
experiences.setup: Two 6-ft tables and two outlets; we bring everything else.
experiences.branding: Cup sleeves and labels with your logo. Needs 10 days.

giftNote: Each kit has the recipient's name on the label and a handwritten card. Hand-delivered in SF; recipients confirm their address first.

gifts.name: Personalized coffee kit, hand-delivered
gifts.desc: A phin filter, 250 g of coffee labelled with their name, condensed milk and a brew card, delivered by hand in SF. Recipients confirm an address or decline.
gifts.ships: Hand-delivered in SF; shipped elsewhere in the US
gifts.allIn: Kit, personalization, delivery in SF and tax.
